decisions.summary: Two write sessions (S1: Q1+Q3; S2: Q2+Q4), each followed by a check-and-apply session, in two sibling clones; then the reply; no code, map or canon change.
decisions.why: Execution arrangement for all four questions; nothing the request asks for is dropped. 'No code, map or canon change' matches a research request that asks only for figures.

decisions.summary: Search passes are leads, not citations; each write session reads every passage before citing it and corrects mis-recorded ledger outcomes.
decisions.why: A stricter way to answer the same questions; removes nothing from the request.

decisions.summary: Q1 as a new money question: kibyoshi retail per 5-leaf volume (two tertiary figures unreconciled), Tenpo gokan/yomihon trade prices labeled wholesale, lending fees per volume; classic/primer/reference volume price SILENT with its search; Japanese copyist rate SILENT, lumped fair-copy fee given as such; China beside: late-Ming prices per volume/juan, hand copy under 0.4 tael, Siku copyists 1,000 characters a day; canon contrast.
decisions.why: Each item of request section 1 (booklet, ordinary bound volume, loan, copyist's rate and daily output, Japan first with China beside) is carried, either as a figure or as SILENT with its search. SILENT with a search is how the record answers 'do we know', not a removal of the item; the request's 'Do we know what books cost?' is answered by it. Japan-first/China-beside is the request's own region order, not comparative scope under FR-001.

decisions.summary: Q2 in 0275 or a sibling: live-in clerk by seniority, scribe by the day, armed escort of goods/cash and biaoju per day or trip, household cook, lord's cook, lady's maid with in-kind part; Kanazawa lead confirmed/narrowed/contradicted and cited from its own work; canon contrast.
decisions.why: Restates request section 2 item by item (a, b, c, in-kind part, the Kanazawa lead, canon) with nothing removed.

decisions.summary: Q3 as a new question beside 0276: tool price vs iron (Qing Beijing 1736 government list ATTESTED ONLY FOR that; Japan 1822 Sakai hoe and 1841 Echizen repairs, iron in rice per kan, any ratio stated as project arithmetic, unreconciled where sources are); charcoal in the itinerant model; output a year (Takefu aggregate, Sakai tobacco knives a night); gross and net income SILENT; crew size ATTESTED; rice payment ATTESTED ONLY FOR 20th c.; Edo carpenter's year as second case, third-hand.
decisions.why: Every element of request section 3 (price vs input, items a year, gross and net, apprentices/journeymen, a second craft) is carried as a figure or SILENT with its search. The second case is one the request itself offers (a carpenter-master). Labeling cross-source ratios as this project's arithmetic is a qualifier on an answer, not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: Q4 beside 0266 or in it: traveling troupe takings per performance and year and sharing, street performer's day, star actor's yearly pay, traveling/rural troupe size, costume (ordinary and fine), shamisen, flute, tsuzumi; Japan first, China beside; canon contrast (county troupe 5-10, market day, magistrate's manor; hinin).
decisions.why: Restates request section 4 clause by clause with nothing removed.

decisions.summary: implementation-check.md holds each touched question's line; reply on #19 gives each figure with fragment and verdict, figures the E0169-E0193 estimates can be graded against; GM findings through escalation-check.
decisions.why: Implements FR-003/FR-004; grading the estimates is named in the request itself.

decisions.summary: S1 write then C1 check in the marks clone; citation rules, 20,000-byte cap, four questions/ten keys per write; SILENT never estimated; disagreeing sources both given; done when record-owed is clean for the two new questions.
decisions.why: Operational constraints and exits consistent with the request and FR-002; no item of Q1 or Q3 is excluded.

decisions.summary: S2 write then C2 check in the pages clone after the Q2/Q4 passes; same constraints; Kanazawa lead cited only from its own work; done when record-owed clean for the touched questions.
decisions.why: Operational; carries all of Q2 and Q4.

decisions.summary: After T01 and T02: make impl-check F=423, escalation-check, reply posted, feature-report.
Principles I-XI and performance bookends N/A (no generator change); question tasks research: physical; record tests green.
decisions.why: Settles process gates only; decides nothing about what the request asked.
